name: Chris Crawford
original_name: クリス・クロフォード
source:
Chris is [url=/c17131]Masato[/url]'s best friend (according to Masato himself) and is also in the same class as him. While most of the students are intensively involved in combat, Chris is involved in the "mechanics team" and therefore takes care of the repairs of the equipment. He is ranked first of all in this category, and many students are fighting to have him on their teams as a mechanic.

Of a docile and very kind nature, he is often dragged (without wishing it) into all the stories of the boys in the dormitory, even the crispiest of them. [spoiler]Chris is actually a girl.[/spoiler]
